title: -fips images are no longer published — FIPS is a runtime switch on the standard image

detection.reason: read from the image TAG of the ebs-csi-controller / ebs-csi-node workloads — a digest-pinned image (@sha256:…) or a mirror that renames the tag is not resolved and reads clean

quote: The `-fips` container images are no longer built or released.
remediation: Replace -fips image overrides with the standard image and turn FIPS on at runtime instead (EKS add-on / Helm `fips: true`): v1.62 is the last -fips image and from v1.63 none are published, so an override pinned to a -fips tag cannot move to any newer release.
verifyCommand: kubectl get deploy,ds -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.metadata.name | test("^ebs-csi-(controller|node(-.+)?)$")) | .metadata.namespace as $n | .metadata.name as $w | .spec.template.spec.containers[] | select(.image | test("-fips")) | "\($n)/\($w): \(.image)"'  # each printed container pins a -fips image that is no longer published
